limitations: Exact-real native circuit only. No native float32, approximation, CKKS or refresh error bound.
Q/K bounds precede head normalization and RoPE; exact causal softmax convexity bounds values independently of Q/K magnitudes.
Lower epsilon is the exact configured binary64 number; float32 epsilon rounding is separate.
Residual, row-L2, Frobenius and L1 envelopes discard correlations and can be impractically loose.
Approximate attention needs nonnegative/row-L1 and norm-multiplier proofs before any propagation transfer.
Illustrative ideal Newton costs use an abstract exact seed, exclude actual coefficients/rounding and are not minimum depths.
No coefficients selected, prompts evaluated or validation extrema used. lm_head is outside the RMS input graph.
